INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.title: How to Choose Between Analog HD and IP Surveillance in Bangladesh
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.author: CamneX Technical Team
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.excerpt: An objective engineering breakdown comparing cost, cable distance, image clarity, and long-term expandability.
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.content: When planning a surveillance deployment in Dhaka, property owners frequently balance budget constraints against technical longevity. Analog HD (Turbo HD / HD-TVI) remains cost-effective for 2 to 8 camera residential layouts, whereas IP PoE solutions provide unmatched scalability and analytics for multi-story corporate facilities...

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Are all Hikvision and ZKTeco products 100% genuine?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. Every device supplied by CamneX Bangladesh carries an authentic factory serial number verifiable through official manufacturer partner verification channels, accompanied by warranty documentation.

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Can I view surveillance streams on my smartphone outside Bangladesh?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. We configure encrypted cloud P2P (Hik-Connect / DMSS) on your smartphones and laptops, allowing live streaming and playback review globally without static IP requirements.

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Do you offer on-site surveys in Dhaka?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. A qualified engineer can visit your premises anywhere in Dhaka to assess blind spots, measure cable lengths, and formulate an itemized bill of materials.
